notes.title: Patch notes and Repairs- Welcome back XBOX Controller :P
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33697994/342a88b898d8d9ddb54d336d6605e7b529bb7e40.jpg[/img]

Soooo.. I kinda broke the controller support without knowing it. Its back! XBOX Controller is working and back to full fitness.

[h1]Score Panel Issues ? [/h1]

If you are having any issues with the scores panels not loading please let me know! They work in game for me but when making the game they have issues.

Also if you have a jerky lag every couple of seconds please let me know! A couple of people have told me they are having this issue. I have made a repair to this and it should be fixed. If not please let me know asap.

Patch is now live :)

notes.title: Defender 3D ready for Live this week! (99% pre-release)
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33697994/6e869e449ba5d2553003578df66e056d7966b986.jpg[/img]

I have pretty much completed the final stages of Defender 3D so I am going to make the game live this week instead of on the 1st of November. I had a couple of issues with Steam achievements at the weekend but these are now fixed.

I have added 3 bosses, 4 player ships and 5 enemy types. This will give players a good challenge and let me get some feedback on what to add next to the game.

I am going to launch with a 20% discount as well so have fun and if you have any feedback please PM me or post in the forum.

Defender 3D will always be progressing so this is a soft launch. I will be looking for player and enemy ship builders for the end of November. I will also be adding the final 2 bosses from the current batch before November 1st.

Game will be live by 5pm GMT today.

notes.title: Release Date Confirmed
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33697994/95645fc3ed4a3c3d1f38ab2dea2dac3f28a2d435.png[/img]

I have set the release date for Defender to November 1st. This will give me a chance to iron out the final bugs and add new alien crafts to the game.

I was going to release the game as early access but the game is almost finished so early access would be pointless.

I have not decided on a final release price for Defender yet. I will announce this closer to the release date.

If you have already played using one of the beta keys please feel free to give me feedback by PM or in the forums.

If you would like to add any alien crafts, bosses or player ships to the game before release please let me know. You will need a 3d modelling platform such as Blender. I can then use your model and add it to the game very quickly.
